JUSTIFICATION FOR FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION SOLICITATION SPE7M225R0005 Over the past 30-plus years, aircraft have continued to increase

in weight, while many of the ALRE systems and components have not undergone significant redesign to accommodate these higher energy loads, . In response, NAVAIR established the ALRE Flight Safe Program, which governs the life- cycle management of ALRE Critical Safety Items (CSI) and Critical Application Items (CAI). ALRE CSI and CAI are identified in the DLA Enterprise Business Systems (EBS) Material Master, Classification Tab, CIM sub-tab, with a Special Procedures Code (SPC) of “01.” NAVAIR designates ALRE items as CSI or CAI through the Navy Joint Deficiency Reporting System, which feeds the code (SPC-01) into EBS. Technical Data Requirements (TDR) containing a list of approved sources, as designated by NAVAIR and NAVSUP, are required for all such items. When an ALRE item is coded SPC- 01, DLA procures as instructed per the TDR from the list of approved sources in accordance with NAVAIRISNT 13800.18A. It has been demonstrated that CAGE (0A0B7) Mainstream Engineering possesses the unique and proven manufacturing capabilities to establish and maintain the process controls to manufacture this item and are the only sources known to possess the manufacturing knowledge and capability to produce the item to required quality standards. The desired solution is an integrated suite of swarm-replication software, target-control networks, and multi-sensor tracking algorithms designed to evaluate defensive weapon systems against high-density autonomous threats. The solution should deliver: • Swarm Replication & C2: An advanced, highly scalable target command and control system capable of orchestrating and simulating the coordinated tactics of large-scale (50+ units) autonomous drone swarms. • Passive Multi-Sensor Fusion: Advanced tracking algorithms capable of fusing passive optical and radar sensor data to reliably track low-signature swarms in GPS-denied and RF-contested environments. • High-Density TSPI: Miniaturized, high-precision Time-Space-Position Information (TSPI) instrumentation suitable for deployment on small, low-cost target drones to capture precise intercept trajectories. 3 • Realistic Threat Behaviors: Software-defined threat profiles that can adapt and react dynamically to defensive actions, replacing static, predictable target paths with representative adversary tactics. 4. The desired solution is an integrated suite of swarm-replication software, target-control networks, and multi-sensor tracking algorithms designed to evaluate defensive weapon systems against high-density autonomous threats. The solution should deliver: • Swarm Replication & C2: An advanced, highly scalable target command and control system capable of orchestrating and simulating the coordinated tactics of large-scale (50+ units) autonomous drone swarms. • Passive Multi-Sensor Fusion: Advanced tracking algorithms capable of fusing passive optical and radar sensor data to reliably track low-signature swarms in GPS-denied and RF-contested environments. • High-Density TSPI: Miniaturized, high-precision Time-Space-Position Information (TSPI) instrumentation suitable for deployment on small, low-cost target drones to capture precise intercept trajectories. 3 • Realistic Threat Behaviors: Software-defined threat profiles that can adapt and react dynamically to defensive actions, replacing static, predictable target paths with representative adversary tactics. 4. Hankija lükkab tagasi pakkumuse, mille alusel sõlmitav hankeleping oleks RSanS § 7 lg 1 alusel tühine. Küsimused ett

must iseloomustavaid numbrilisi näitajaid; 3) asjade ja ehitustööde hankelepingute puhul lisaks punktis 1 nimetatule muid pakkumuste hindamise kriteeriumidele vastavaid pakkumust iseloomustavaid näitajaid (RHS § 46 ülamärkega 1). Küsimused ettevõtjale: 1. Kirjeldage lühidalt pakkumuses sisalduvat ärisaladust ja lisage selle määramise põhjendus või märkige, et pakkumus ei sisalda ärisaladust. (Suur sisestusala (max pikkus 4000 tähemärki)) EL NÕUKOGU SANKTSIOON. ALLTÖÖVÕTJAD JA TARNIJAD. Pakkuja kinnitab, et ta ei kaasa üle 10% hankelepingu maksumusest hankelepingu täitmisele alltöövõtjaid ega tarnijaid, kes on: 1. Vene Föderatsiooni kodanik, resident või Vene Föderatsioonis asutatud ettevõtja, sh füüsilisest isikust ettevõtja, juriidiline isik, asutus või muu üksus; 2. rohkem kui 50% ulatuses otseselt või kaudselt punktis 1 nimetatud isiku, asutuse või muu üksuse omandis; 3. punktis 1 või 2 nimetatud isiku, asutuse või muu üksuse esindaja või tegutseb sellise isiku juhiste alusel. Hankija lükkab tagasi pakkumuse, mille alusel sõlmitav hankeleping oleks RSanS § 7 lg 1 alusel tühine. Määrust kohaldatakse riigihangetele alates rahvusvahelisest piirmäärast.
